title: Messages stuck at the bottom of the chat — the note's new look

steps.path: A message the app never hears back about, 30 seconds after sending
steps.headline: "Not sure this was sent" now sits in the app's standard amber notice box, with its button inside and an ✕ to dismiss.
steps.changed: The grey words and flat buttons under the message became the design guide's tinted notice box: amber because it is a doubt, not a failure. Dismiss is now the box's ✕, like the chat's other dismissible notices. It now appears after 30 seconds, as you picked.
steps.notice: The note looks like every other warning in the app. Send again stays outlined here, not filled, because pressing it for a message that did arrive would send it twice.
steps.risk: The box is a little taller than the old line of text.

steps.path: A message the computer says it never received (a phone that lost its connection mid-send)
steps.headline: "This didn't send" uses the red version of the same box, with Discard and a filled Send again.
steps.changed: Same change for the other note, which shows when the computer's record proves a message never arrived. Red because that one is a known failure; Send again is the filled main button because resending cannot duplicate anything.
steps.notice: The two notes now differ by colour as well as wording: amber means maybe, red means definitely not.
steps.risk: None beyond the slightly taller box.
